announcements.raw_caption: 𝐀 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐝𝐢𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞. Suicide prevention means creating spaces where people feel safe to speak, heard without judgment, and supported when things become difficult. We may not always know what someone is going through, but we can choose to listen, reach out, and take their struggles seriously. This Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, let’s be willing to start the conversation. Listen with compassion. Reach out. Let someone know they don’t have to face everything alone. If you or someone you know is struggling, support is available: 💙 LSPU San Pablo - Guidance Office 📞 (049) 554-9910 EXT. 3012 📧 guidance_spc@lspu.edu.ph 💙 @National Center for Mental Health (NCMH) Crisis Hotline 📞 1553 📱 0917-899-8727 / 0966-351-4518 💙 @Hopeline Philippines 📞 (02) 8804-4673 📱 0917-558-4673 / 0918-873-4673 💙 @In Touch Crisis Line 📞 (02) 8893-7603 📱 0917-800-1123 / 0922-893-8944 You don’t have to have the perfect words to reach out. Sometimes, starting the conversation is already a step toward help. 💙 #KaPeerYu #KaibiganParaSayo #LSPU #LSPUSPCC #SuicidePreventionAwarenessMonth #MentalHealthAwareness

announcements.title: Congratulations to our new Registered Guidance Counselors!
announcements.raw_caption: Congratulations to our new Registered Guidance Counselors! 🤍 #LSPUNews | 𝗖𝗧𝗘 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲𝘀 𝟭𝟬 𝗻𝗲𝘄 𝗥𝗚𝗖𝘀 The College of Teacher Education (CTE) of the Laguna State Polytechnic University (LSPU) celebrates the milestone of its 10 graduates who are now officially recognized as Registered Guidance Counselors (RGCs) after passing the August 2026 Guidance Counselor Licensure Examination (GCLE), Aug. 25. According to the results released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), the LSPU-San Pablo City Campus produced nine passers while the LSPU-Siniloan Campus produced one passer. Congratulations, new RGCs! #LSPUWhereLeadersBegin Read also here: https://lspu.edu.ph/news/cte-produces-10-new-rgcs

announcements.title: Be part of the Ka-Peer Yu, mga ka-piyu! 🩵
announcements.raw_caption: Be part of the Ka-Peer Yu, mga ka-piyu! 🩵 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐞𝐞𝐫 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮. Ka-Peer Yu is LSPU’s dedicated peer advocate organization, fostering a safe, inclusive, and judgment-free space where every Ka-Piyu feels heard and valued. At our heart is volunteerism—standing alongside our peers through academic and personal challenges without discrimination. 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐖𝐞 𝐎𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫: 💙 Peer Support & Listening — A safe space to talk and be understood. 💙 Mental Health Advocacy — Awareness campaigns and seminars building student resilience. 💙 Workshops & Volunteerism — Interactive activities empowering our campus community. 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐲 𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐞: https://forms.gle/sqUJt6iMghhoKPv27 or 𝐒𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐐𝐑 𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦! Applications are extended until September 10, 2026, 11:59PM. Dito sa Ka-Peer Yu, totoong may Kaibigan Para Sa 'Yo. 🫂 #kapeeryu #lspu #friendship #mentalhealthawareness #mentalhealthadvocates
